topic: How AI qualifies your leads before you ever pick up the phone
findings: Contractors and small businesses that respond to a new lead within 5 minutes are 21x more likely to qualify that lead than those who wait 30 minutes
Calling a web lead within 1 minute of submission makes a prospect 391% more likely to convert than calling any time after
58% of small businesses now use generative AI, up from 40% in 2024
Businesses implementing AI call/lead automation report 40-60% increases in lead capture rate, largely by responding to missed calls or inbound leads within 30 seconds via automated follow-up
